# `video` — Video clip pipeline: CLI reference

> **Generated file — do not edit.** Rendered from the spec registry
> (`geneva_examples/examples/video/__init__.py`) by `geneva_examples/docs_gen/`;
> regenerate with `make docs`. The same text is shown by `uv run <command> --help`.
> Docs index: [`docs/README.md`](../../README.md).

Ingest videos, chunk them into fixed-length clips with a start frame, then backfill per-frame features. Two ingest/chunk variants: local MP4 downloads, or reference-only OpenVid blobs.

Order: **ingest → chunk → frame-\***.

**Modality:** `video` · **Steps in pipeline order:** [`ingest-videos`](#ingest-videos) → [`ingest-videos-openvid`](#ingest-videos-openvid) → [`ingest-videos-external`](#ingest-videos-external) → [`chunk-videos`](#chunk-videos) → [`chunk-videos-openvid`](#chunk-videos-openvid) → [`chunk-videos-external`](#chunk-videos-external) → [`frame-embed`](#frame-embed) → [`frame-caption`](#frame-caption) → [`frame-openpose`](#frame-openpose) → [`seed-video-clips`](#seed-video-clips)

Every command below is generated by `geneva_examples/core/spec.py` (`build_command`) and accepts these options in addition to its own:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--config` | path | `None` | Path to config.yaml (default ./config.yaml). |

A `None` default is resolved at runtime: `--mode` and `--db-uri` follow the config-file precedence, and some model steps resolve `--num-gpus None` to a per-step GPU fraction inside their `run()` (see the step's source file).

**Ingest videos**

|---|---|---|---|

| `--cache-dir` | str | `./video_cache` | Directory to cache downloaded videos. |
| `--frag-size` | int | `1` | Rows per record batch. |
| `--overwrite` / `--no-overwrite` | flag | `--overwrite` | Drop the table first if it already exists. |

**Ingest videos (OpenVid, reference-only)**

Register the first N rows of the OpenVid Lance dataset as a reference-only `videos` table (metadata + a blob pointer, no bytes). The chunker reads each clip's blob directly on the worker.

|---|---|
| Run | `uv run ingest-videos-openvid [OPTIONS]` |

| Mode default | config-driven (`--mode` unset) |

|---|---|---|---|
| `--table-name` | str | `videos` | Table to operate on. |
| `--limit` | int | `256` | Max OpenVid rows to ingest (first N in scan order). |
| `--batch-size` | int | `256` | DataLoader batch size (auto-shrunk locally). |
| `--openvid-uri` | str | `hf://datasets/lance-format/openvid-lance/data` | Base URI holding the OpenVid lance dataset. |
| `--openvid-table` | str | `train` | OpenVid dataset name (\<uri\>/\<table\>.lance). |
| `--skip-null-video` / `--no-skip-null-video` | flag | `--skip-null-video` | Drop rows whose video bytes are null. |

| `--table-write-retries` | int | `5` | Retries for create/add ops. |

## `frame-embed`

**OpenCLIP embeddings on frames**

Backfill an OpenCLIP embedding on each clip's start frame.

| | |
|---|---|
| Run | `uv run frame-embed [OPTIONS]` |
| GPU | yes — runs a model (CPU-only in local mode) |
| Prerequisite | run a chunk step first |
| Mode default | config-driven (`--mode` unset) |
| Source | `geneva_examples/examples/video/frame_embed.py` (`run()`), spec in `geneva_examples/examples/video/__init__.py` |

In addition to the [common options](#common-options-every-command):

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--table-name` | str | `video_clips` | Table to operate on. |
| `--input-column` | str | `frame` | Column of encoded images. |
| `--output-column` | str | `embedding` | Output column name. |
| `--model-name` | str | `ViT-B-32` | OpenCLIP architecture. |
| `--pretrained` | str | `laion2b_s34b_b79k` | OpenCLIP pretrained tag for --model-name. |
| `--dim` | int | `512` | Embedding dimension; MUST match --model-name. |
| `--batch-size` | int | `256` | DataLoader batch size (auto-shrunk locally). |
| `--num-workers` | int | `12` | DataLoader worker processes (0 locally). |
| `--num-cpus` | float | `4.0` | CPUs per task (capped to the machine locally). |
| `--num-gpus` | float | `None` | GPUs per task (forced to 0 locally). |
| `--memory-gib` | int | `1` | Memory (GiB) per task (geneva caps <2). |
| `--checkpoint-size` | int | `65536` | Rows per checkpoint / UDF __call__. |
| `--task-size` | int | `65536` | Rows per read task. |
| `--concurrency` | int | `16` | Backfill/refresh concurrency (1 locally). |
| `--backfill-timeout-min` | int | `1000` | Per-backfill timeout (minutes). |
| `--flush-interval-s` | float | `30.0` | Checkpoint flush interval (seconds). |
| `--schema-wait-attempts` | int | `30` | Schema-visibility attempts. |
| `--schema-wait-sleep-s` | int | `2` | Seconds between schema checks. |
| `--reset` / `--no-reset` | flag | `--no-reset` | Drop and recompute the whole embedding column (destructive). Default off = incremental: only embed clips still missing it, so re-runs are cheap. Either way run it after the chunk job completes — the column add breaks a running chunker's appends. |
